titleEn: Resize a ring and collect it
canDoYue: 你識講戒指太緊，要求改大半碼，再用保養同收據約星期六取。
canDoEn: Say a ring is tight, ask for half a size larger, and collect it on Saturday under the warranty.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: This ring is too tight on my finger.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢隻戒指戴住太緊，我仲有張收據。
dialogue.say: This ring is too tight on my finger.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: A tight ring needs one larger opening.
dialogue.glossYue: 太緊嘅戒指要開大少少，收據上面有完整購買日期。
dialogue.say: A tight ring needs one larger opening.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Can you make the ring half a size larger, and when can I collect it?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以將戒指改大半碼，幾時可以取？
dialogue.say: Can you make the ring half a size larger, and when can I collect it?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: We can make the ring half a size larger, and you collect it Saturday.
dialogue.glossYue: 戒指可以改大半碼，星期六可以取。
dialogue.say: We can make the ring half a size larger, and you collect it Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: How long does the warranty work take, and may I collect it on Saturday?
dialogue.glossYue: 保養工作要幾耐，星期六可唔可以取？
dialogue.say: How long does the warranty work take, and may I collect it on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The warranty work is ready on Saturday, and the charge is nothing at all.
dialogue.glossYue: 保養工作星期六做好，完全唔使錢。
dialogue.say: The warranty work is ready on Saturday, and the charge is nothing at all.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: I will bring the receipt on Saturday and pay nothing for this warranty work.
dialogue.glossYue: 我星期六會帶收據，呢次保養工作唔使畀錢。
dialogue.say: I will bring the receipt on Saturday and pay nothing for this warranty work.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Please bring that receipt with you.
dialogue.say: Please bring that receipt with you.
